name: B10-0530/2026 (PfE) – Soutien à la candidature de villes de l'Union pour accueillir un nouveau pôle des Nations unies pour l’évaluation indépendante et la gouvernance éthique de l’IA
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion, not changing any law. It backs bids by European cities, especially Milan, to host a new United Nations body that would independently test artificial intelligence systems and set shared ethical standards. The Parliament says such a body would help countries judge AI using evidence rather than rushed rules, and would let Europe play a bigger part in global talks on AI. It asks the European Commission, member states and the United Nations to support these city bids.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states support for EU cities, especially Milan, hosting a new UN AI assessment body.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the European Commission, the United Nations and its member states, plus universities and tech firms.
- **What happens next:** Parliament asks the Commission and member states to promote these bids in talks with the UN, which decides the host.
